## 1. `ABCExceptions.Section2`

- **Definition** `Finset.abcExceptionsBelow`
  `(ε : Real) (X : Nat) : Finset (Prod Nat (Prod Nat Nat))`
  — The set (as a `Finset`) of exceptions to the abc conjecture at `ε` inside [1, X] ^ 3, in particular the set of triples `(a, b, c)` which are * pairwise coprime, * contained in `[1, X] ^ 3`, * satisfy `a + b = c`, * have `radical (a * b * c) < c ^ (1 - ε)` Note this has a slight difference from the usual formulation, which has `radical (a * b * c) ^ (1 + ε) < c` instead.
  <details><summary>Full Lean statement</summary><code>Real → Nat → Finset (Prod Nat (Prod Nat Nat))</code></details>
- **Definition** `countTriples`
  `(ε : Real) (X : Nat) : Nat`
  — The number of exceptions to the abc conjecture for a given `ε` which are bounded by `X`.
  <details><summary>Full Lean statement</summary><code>Real → Nat → Nat</code></details>
- **Definition** `abcExceptions`
  `(ε : Real) : Set (Prod Nat (Prod Nat Nat))`
  — The set of exceptions to the abc conjecture for `ε`, in particular the set of triples `(a, b, c)` which are * pairwise coprime, * positive, * satisfy `a + b = c`, * have `radical (a * b * c) ^ (1 + ε) < c`
  <details><summary>Full Lean statement</summary><code>Real → Set (Prod Nat (Prod Nat Nat))</code></details>
